"1.  There is an illness slip reported of Sri S.F.A Naqvi and Sri Faizan Ahmad, learned counsels for the applicant.
2. Sri Shashi Kant Pandey, learned counsel for the State is present.
3. In view of the same, the matter is adjourned for today.

sentences.text: Let the matter be listed on 14.08.2024 peremptorily."
3. Today again, illness slip of Sri Faizan Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant has been reported by the office.

4. There is one other learned counsel appearing for the applicant but he is not present.
5.
On 31.07.2024, the matter was directed to be listed peremptorily today and is listed as such.
In view of the same the matter is taken up.
6. Sri Shashi Kant Pandey, learned counsel for the State of U.P. is present and has been heard.

7. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Tausiful Hasan with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 30 of 2014 (State vs. Tausiful Hasan),
pending in the court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Court no. 7, Kanpur Nagar, arising out of Case Crime No. 168 of 2012, under Sections 376, 328, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3(2)V S.C./S.T. Act, Police Station Juhi, District Kanpur Nagar as well as charge sheet dated 06.03.2014.

9. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as infructuous.
10. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

11. Office to communicate this order to the trial court concerned within two weeks.
12.

13. Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
